writeup: Schluter's Kerdi-Shower-LT 48 by 48 inch linear shower tray (KSLT1220S) is a prefabricated sloped polystyrene tray with Kerdi waterproofing built in, made for a wall-side Kerdi-Line linear drain, which is sold separately. Woot has it new for $131.99, about half what Lowe's, Ferguson and Floor & Decor charge. Quantities are very low, with two showing on each listing.
